svg.title: Who answers "are you sure?": a confirm flag vs. MCP
svg.desc: Two panels, one above the other. Your agent tried to delete the wrong Linkly link, /r/wasp. With a confirm flag on an API or CLI, Linkly asks "confirm=true?", the client (where you are) just passes the question on to the model, the model answers confirm=true itself, and /r/wasp is deleted. You're never asked. With MCP, Linkly asks "are you sure?" and the question goes to the client, which opens Linkly's confirmation page right where you are: "Delete /r/wasp?" You click Cancel, the answer goes straight back to Linkly, and nothing is deleted. The model never sees the question.

g.text: WITH A CONFIRM FLAG (API OR CLI)
